reason: The external reviewer recommends acceptance and accepts the R14 attribution-audit thesis. R15 addresses clarification and existing-data requests without expanding the current narrow scientific object.

question_closure.r15_change: States that the margin itself was prospectively frozen but no variance-based power rationale was preregistered; adds post-review future-design power planning (portfolio observed SD: n=27 gives ~80.7%; C4 observed SD: n~110 gives ~80.7%).
Clarifies that G is a mechanism-misaligned stress comparator and G0 a same-surface no-op placebo; a new benign generic is a distinct future treatment and is not run for score chasing.
Adds a prospective multi-turn design sketch with episode-level units, synchronized exact outputs, and separate availability versus placement estimands.

question_closure.topic: per-endpoint Rsurf residuals and non-tie errors
question_closure.r15_change: Publishes all 18 endpoint residuals and analyzes the two opposite-signed non-ties (+50pp and -50pp), each driven by one repeat while the exact operation output remains matched.

Makes the frozen full-task exact-score trade-off explicit: grounding is unchanged, while cutoff/alignment collapse because the conjunctive score adds orthogonal fields and exact-form requirements; it is a different estimand, not a stricter version of the family scorer.
Adds minimal S/O/Y intervention bookkeeping and explicitly states that it is not a full SCM or mediation-identification result.

question_closure.topic: future stratum neutrality and sample size
question_closure.r15_change: Requires future independent endpoint counts and stopping rules to be frozen before outcomes; forbids adaptive expansion until an equivalence test passes.
